info.title: PHFrame HTTP API
info.summary: Generated dataset, analytics, data-intelligence, publishing, and governed AI APIs.
info.description: Routes and methods are covered by the PHFrame stability policy (docs/api-stability.md). Record endpoints are generated for every dataset in phframe.yaml, so `{dataset}` is a configured dataset name and record fields follow that dataset's schema. JSON responses wrap results in `data`; errors use the `Error` schema. When `access_mode` is `private`, requests need a `phframe_session` cookie from `/api/auth/login`; write requests may instead send `Authorization: Bearer $PHFRAME_API_TOKEN`.
